label: VERIFIED
extraction: Delivery Gate three deterministic checks with blocking logic. Check 1: Rationalization patterns (regex on transcript tail) - patterns: 'skip tests for now', 'pre-existing bug', 'will fix later', 'good enough for now' - WARNING ONLY, never blocks. Check 2: Stale learning libraries (mtime on 5 paths: growth-log/, decisions/log.md, output-index.md, ratings-tracker.md, tooling_capabilities.md) - WARNING if some stale, BLOCK if >=3 stale OR growth-log stale + complex task (>=3 edits). Check 3: Disk space - WARNING <50GB, BLOCK <15GB. Learning libraries config: LIBS dict in quality-gate.py. COMPLEX_THRESHOLD=3 edits to classify as complex. DISK_WARN_GB=50, DISK_CRIT_GB=15. Installs as Stop hook in ~/.claude/settings.json. Distinct from self-audit: delivery-gate checks machine-verifiable facts, self-audit checks output quality.
